text:
Maria: Hey — pushed a follow-up to PR #4823: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4823. I addressed the retry/backoff feedback and the shard-fallback edge case. PTAL when you have a sec. I added a tiny smoke script and one unit test to cover the race.
Kevin: Looking now.
deploy-bot: CI started for commit 4d3f9b2
Kevin: Quick note — I left an inline nit about the waitgroup name and one suggestion about a shorter sleep in the test. Otherwise this looks fine.
Maria: Thanks — good catch. Renamed wg -> workerGroup and replaced the sleep with a wait on the signal channel. Force-pushed. Smoke script is at infra/tests/smoke/shard_fallback.sh (runs locally with `./smoke.sh --quick`).
Maria: Diff (excerpt):

```diff
-    var wg sync.WaitGroup
-    wg.Add(1)
-    go func() {
-        defer wg.Done()
-        time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
-        s.triggerFallback()
-    }()
+    var workerGroup sync.WaitGroup
+    workerGroup.Add(1)
+    go func() {
+        defer workerGroup.Done()
+        <-s.fallbackSignal
+        s.triggerFallback()
+    }()
```
Kevin: Nice — that signal makes the test deterministic. Running the local smoke now.
deploy-bot: ✅ unit tests: 128 passed, 0 failed. Build: success (job/4123). Code coverage unchanged.
Sam: LGTM from my side. One ops note: we usually prefer to schedule canary merges outside the 14:00-20:00 PST block. Any chance to move to 02:00 UTC tomorrow? Otherwise hold until morning.
Maria: I can schedule the canary at 02:00 UTC tomorrow. If Kevin approves, I'll kick it off and add a note in the release calendar and #eng-oncall.
Kevin: Approved. :thumbsup:
Maria: Thanks all — merging to canary at 02:00 UTC and I'll follow up with rollout status. PTAL if anything else pops up.
